_comment: Cross-surface chip cases. The desktop reads this from chips.test.ts and iOS
reads the same file from its test bundle (ADETests/WorkComposerTriggerDetectorTests).
It exists because iOS re-implements chips.ts and deeplinks.ts in Swift and
cannot import the TypeScript. Hand-written twin tests prove today's parity and
nothing about tomorrow's: two divergences were already found by review rather
than by a failing test. Adding a row here fails the iOS suite until Swift
matches, which is the only mechanism that makes silent divergence impossible.
Add a row for every new deeplink shape. `label` is the compact display label.

NOTE: ade://pr/<number> without owner/repo is REJECTED by parseDeeplink and is
deliberately absent — it must stay a generic ADE link on every surface.
